author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
A quick mailbag unboxing turns into a mini repair build as Adam receives one of the hero props from The Expanse! He's always loved Amos's auto-shotgun prop, and this pieces from production arrives to his collection with a damaged stock hinge. Fortunately, Adam has the exact airsoft replica that looks to be the source model for this prop and can swap out parts to fix the piece!
